column3: Integration-b (origin/wt/integration-b = integration-a plus 12 batch-3 branches: construction, murals, signage, hospital, la-trees, car-dealers, airport-life, golf, dogs, hill-homes, oil-fields, vacant-lots) cannot be gated: its smoke test was OOM-killed at 10.9 GB peak right after "city scene loads" (integration-a peaks near 3 GB). Start wt/oom-fix from origin/wt/integration-b. Write a small probe (SceneTree script) that loads scenes/levels/city.tscn as tests/smoke_test.gd does, waits ~300 physics frames and prints VmHWM / VmRSS from /proc/self/status at each stage; run it with everything on, then with each batch-3 switch =0 in turn (CONSTRUCTION, MURALS, BOULEVARD_SIGNS, HOSPITALS, LA_TREES, CAR_DEALERS, AIRPORT_GROUND, GOLF + GOLF_LIFE, DOGS + DOG_YARDS, HILL_HOMES, OIL_FIELD, VACANT_LOTS); bisect inside the culprit (caches keyed per instance instead of per kind, meshes built per block, big arrays per chunk, far-city capture). Fix the cause while keeping the feature; then the full gate must pass with peak RSS under 4 GB (measure it). Push wt/oom-fix. Report the culprit, before/after peak memory and the gate result. Stills only if you change something visible.

Bring origin/wt/alleys (service alleys behind blocks) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve every conflict keeping both sides' intent (read each hunk), fix whatever the merge breaks, make the full headless gate pass, re-shoot its key stills on the merged tree (shots/alleys already exists: add to it), and push wt/alleys. Do not add features; review its own code for bugs and the CLAUDE.md rules (hash rolls, no rng drift, frame cost) and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/scooters (e-scooters, share bikes, bike lanes, cyclists) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills on the merged tree (add to shots/scooters), push wt/scooters. No new features; review its code for bugs and the CLAUDE.md rules and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/rooftops (tower roofs, helipads, rooftop pools) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills on the merged tree (add to shots/rooftops), push wt/rooftops. No new features; review its code for bugs and the CLAUDE.md rules and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/ridges (transmission lines, antenna farms, fire roads, water tanks on the hills) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills (add to shots/ridges), push wt/ridges. No new features; review its code for bugs and the CLAUDE.md rules and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/stadium (a ballpark in a ravine north of downtown) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills (add to shots/stadium), push wt/stadium. No new features; review its code for bugs and the CLAUDE.md rules and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/service-vehicles (garbage trucks, street sweepers, tow trucks, delivery vans at work) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent (traffic.gd and big_vehicles.gd changed a lot: schools added SCHOOL_BUS), fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills (add to shots/service-vehicles), push wt/service-vehicles. No new features; review its code and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/wilshire-deco (art-deco boulevard character in midtown) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills (add to shots/wilshire-deco), push wt/wilshire-deco. No new features; review its code and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/reservoir (a hillside reservoir and dam) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, re-shoot key stills (add to shots/reservoir), push wt/reservoir. No new features; review its code and fix what you find.

Bring origin/wt/web-build (the web export's look and errors) up to date: merge origin/fleet/base, resolve conflicts, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, then export the web build locally (export templates from the 4.7.2 GitHub release's export_templates.tpz) and use tools/webshot to check the merged city loads in the browser without errors; fix web-only errors you find (Compatibility renderer, global shader buffer limits, missing fallbacks). Stills of the web build on shots/web-build. Push wt/web-build.

origin/wt/perf-audit has about 9 commits of frame-cost cuts that are not merged anywhere (e.g. "beach town 7.40 -> 4.55 M triangles"). Merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, re-measure every claimed cut with tools/geo_count.gd / still_shot.gd SPLIT=1 on the merged tree (keep the ones that still hold and show no visible change; drop the rest), make the full gate pass, push wt/perf-audit with a before/after table in its HANDOFF section. Then look for the next biggest cuts the 19 newly merged features added (pier, marina, canals, schools, police stations, broadway, stack interchange ...) and make them, with stills proving no visible change.

origin/wt/roadside (gas stations, car washes, diners, auto shops, commercial.gd) was pushed after the last handoff and never reviewed. Merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, shoot stills on the merged tree (add to shots/roadside: day, night, from the street), review its code for bugs and the CLAUDE.md rules and fix what you find, push wt/roadside. Finish anything its HANDOFF section lists as not done if it is small.

origin/wt/traffic-ai (lane changes, merging, honking in traffic.gd) was pushed after the last handoff and never reviewed; it may branch from an older main (git fetch --unshallow). Merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent (traffic.gd changed a lot: buses, school buses, police yielding), fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, shoot stills (add to shots/traffic-ai), review its code and fix what you find, push wt/traffic-ai.

origin/wt/driving-fx (skid marks, tyre smoke, sparks, backfires) was pushed after the last handoff and never reviewed; it may branch from an older main (git fetch --unshallow). Merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, shoot stills (add to shots/driving-fx), review its code and fix what you find, push wt/driving-fx.

origin/wt/freight-trains (freight trains on the industrial rail and the river's tracks) was pushed after the last handoff and never reviewed; it may branch from an older main (git fetch --unshallow). Merge origin/fleet/base into it, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, fix what the merge breaks, make the full gate pass, shoot stills (add to shots/freight-trains), review its code and fix what you find, push wt/freight-trains.

origin/wt/street-life-2 (bus queues that board, shop doors, cars driven off and parked in, jaywalkers, deliveries) was merged once and reverted because its own checks fail even merged alone onto main: the jaywalker check ("ends on its own block") and the bus-queue check ("two walkers stand in the bus stop's queue"). Merge origin/fleet/base into it, root-cause and fix both (fix the feature, not the check, unless the check is wrong - explain which), make the full gate pass, shoot stills (it has none: queue boarding a bus, a jaywalker mid-street, a shop door in use; on shots/street-life-2), push wt/street-life-2. Note: a freshly built bus only gets its BusFittings in _ready(); fleet/base fixes _board_line for that.

origin/wt/sky has one commit beyond what integration-a merged, and the owner's review of its stills says the new cumulus read stylised: smooth triangular puffs at golden hour, uniform blobs at noon. Merge origin/fleet/base into wt/sky, then make the clouds read photographic: ragged, eroded edges (multi-octave erosion of the density near its edge), a far wider size range (small fragments to towering heaps), flat darker bases, grey-violet shadowed bodies on the side away from the sun, wispy fractus, less symmetry. Measure on lavapipe with a small sky-only scene (Forward+) as well as opengl3. Before/after stills at noon, golden hour and dusk on shots/sky. Full gate, push wt/sky.

None of the features merged in integration-a has been seen on Forward+ (the owner's Mac); every still was opengl3 or lavapipe of a different scene. Review, on Forward+ under lavapipe with SMALL scenes only (tools/glshot/forward_shot.sh pattern; never the whole city), the hero's moves (hero-moves), the port at work (port-life), the canals, photo mode, the police stations and the pier park. Look for colour-space errors (CLAUDE.md measurement trap 4: source_color decoded twice, linear numbers in sRGB slots), missing Compatibility fallbacks, z-fighting, wrong normals, AgX blowouts. Fix what you find in those features' own files, with before/after Forward+ stills on shots/fwd-review-a. Full gate, push wt/fwd-review-a.

Same job as fwd-review-a for a different set: the marina, explosions' aftermath (fire spread, smoke columns, debris), climbing plants, building damage, the crowd's new rigs (more-people) and the schools. Forward+ under lavapipe with SMALL scenes only (never the whole city). Look for colour-space errors (CLAUDE.md measurement trap 4), missing Compatibility fallbacks, z-fighting, wrong normals, AgX blowouts. Fix them in those features' own files, before/after Forward+ stills on shots/fwd-review-b. Full gate, push wt/fwd-review-b.

Same job as fwd-review-a for a different set: the weather (marine layer, Santa Ana, heat haze), Broadway's theatre district, the four-level stack interchange and the minimap / full-screen map. Forward+ under lavapipe with SMALL scenes only. Look for colour-space errors (CLAUDE.md measurement trap 4), missing Compatibility fallbacks, z-fighting, wrong normals, AgX blowouts, UI scaling at 1080p and 4K. Fix them in those features' own files, before/after stills on shots/fwd-review-c. Full gate, push wt/fwd-review-c.

The police stations' night stills read very dark (their shot script used a light world without lamps). Make a police station read right at night on Forward+: lit glass lobby, the department name sign lit, car-park floodlights with pools, cruisers' lights, the lamp OmniLights the city really has at night. Fix the shot script so night stills include the real lamps; tune the station's own night materials. Small scene on lavapipe and opengl3. Before/after stills at 21:00 on shots/police-night. Full gate, push wt/police-night.

From the basin at night the hillside estates' pads (HillRoads estates, Skyline's estate MultiMesh and the LOD chunks) read as round grey blobs on the dark hills. Make them read as what they are at night from 1-5 km: dark ground with a few lit windows, garden lights, pool glows, driveway lamps, never a bare grey disc; and by day as pads with houses and gardens rather than grey circles. Look from the basin at 21:00 and noon (still_shot EYE), and from the air. Before/after stills on shots/estate-night. Full gate, push wt/estate-night.

The vinyl lettering the building shader draws on shop glass reads as pseudo-letters ("TSHNEENA"). Make it real words: hours ("OPEN 7 DAYS", "MON-FRI 9-6"), "SALE", "NOW OPEN", "WE ACCEPT", phone numbers in 555, the shop's own name from Building.shop_names() where the shader can know it (a small word atlas or stroke font like port_lettering.gdshaderinc), sized and spaced like real window vinyl, faded under a pixel. Keep the cost flat (it is on every storefront pixel). Close-up and street stills before/after on shots/shop-vinyl. Full gate, push wt/shop-vinyl.

tests/headless_check.sh takes 25-30 minutes, and a fleet of 100 sessions plus a lead that gates every merge is bottlenecked on it. Make it much faster WITHOUT dropping any check or weakening one: profile where the time goes (import, city loads, waits of fixed tick counts that could wait for a condition, repeated city reloads, checks that sleep), cut waits to condition polls with the same timeouts, share one city load between checks that can share it, and if it helps, split the run into parallel shards that each fit in 3-4 GB (a sharded mode next to the plain one; CI keeps working). Report before/after wall time and peak memory, and that the pass/fail list is identical. Push wt/gate-speed.

The merged city's headless smoke test peaks around 3 GB; integration-b's 12 extra features took it to 10.9 GB, and every new feature adds caches. Audit main's memory: what the static caches (static var dictionaries of meshes, materials, plans) hold after a city load and a 2 km drive, what the far city and the LOD ring hold, mesh data kept on the CPU that the renderer already has, textures held twice. Cut the waste without visible change (drop CPU copies, evict per-block plan caches out of range, share identical meshes), measure peak RSS headless and under opengl3 before and after, and add a check that fails if a city load's peak RSS grows past a budget. Push wt/memory-audit.

G7 asks for texture budgeting. Audit every texture the city loads: size, format, mipmaps, VRAM compression (CLAUDE.md: 1K JPG sets, compress/mode=2, mipmaps on, normal maps flagged), duplicates, textures generated in code at load (sizes, formats, mips), atlases larger than they need to be. Fix wrong imports, halve what is oversized for its screen size, report VRAM before/after (RenderingServer texture memory under opengl3 + Xvfb) and stills proving no visible loss at the bookmarks. Push wt/texture-budget.

Measure the loading screen's time on desktop (the LOADING lines it prints, opengl3 + Xvfb) and headless city load time, and cut it: cache what is computed at every launch and could be computed once (bakes, warmed meshes, plan data) where it is safe, parallelise independent warm-ups with WorkerThreadPool where Godot allows it, defer warm-ups the first frame does not need. No visible change, no first-use stutter added back (CLAUDE.md: why things are warmed). Report before/after per stage. Push wt/load-time.

G7: "the landmark towers' far meshes checked against their near ones the same way" as FarBuilding was. For every landmark with a far version (downtown towers, civic set, arena district, airport terminal and tower, pier, observatory, masjid, MacArthur Park's fountain, ...), render near and far from the same camera at the hand-over distance (like tools/glshot/far_building_shot.gd + far_pair.py) and fix what jumps: brightness, colour space, missing crowns, wrong lit windows at night, silhouettes. Before/after pairs on shots/far-landmarks. Push wt/far-landmarks.

G7: "cut-corner geometry on the far boxes": the far city's coded buildings (FarBuilding, building_lod.gdshader) are plain boxes where the near buildings have chamfered, notched or setback outlines and parapets. Add the near outline's corners and setbacks to the far boxes cheaply (a few more instances or a vertex-shader cut keyed by the code), so the skyline from 2-5 km reads like the near city. Keep the far city's triangle and draw budget near flat (measure with tools/far_census.gd and geo_count). Before/after skyline stills on shots/far-corners. Push wt/far-corners.

Occlusion culling covers only building boxes per chunk. Add occluders for what else hides the city: hill terrain (a coarse occluder from the terrain tiles so a ridge hides the valley behind it), the landmark towers and civic sites (their own OccluderInstance3D exists - check), freeway decks seen from under, sound walls, the river's banks. Never bigger than what they stand for (CLAUDE.md OCCLUDER_INSET). Measure draws and triangles at the bookmarks before/after with geo_count, diff stills with OCCLUSION=0 to prove nothing visible is culled. Push wt/occluders.

Find and remove first-use stutters on Forward+: materials or shader variants compiled the first time a thing is seen (a weapon's first explosion, first night, first rain, first blood, the first police car, the first time each landmark streams in). Instrument (time the frames, log pipeline compilations if Godot exposes them), extend the loading screen's warm-ups (LoadingScreen._warm_shaders) to cover what is missing, and verify by scripted play-through under lavapipe with a small scene where possible. Report the worst frame spikes before/after. Push wt/shader-warm.

G4: reflection probes per block and a real HDRI for reflections. On Forward+ only (gate on the renderer; Compatibility keeps today's look), place ReflectionProbes in the FULL chunks round the player (street canyons, plazas, the beach), update mode once or by a budget per frame, with box projection, so car paint, glass towers and wet streets mirror the street they are in instead of the generic sky cubemap; blend with DayNight (re-render on hour or weather change, budgeted). Measure the frame cost on lavapipe in a small scene and keep it bounded (a Quality level gate). Before/after Forward+ stills of a car and a glass tower on shots/reflection-probes. Push wt/reflection-probes.

G1: ten fixed reference cameras and numbers for every push. Build tools/refcams/: ten bookmarks (street noon, street night, sunset, golden aerial, downtown aerial, beach, hills, freeway, MacArthur Park, the pier at night) as EYE + hour + weather, a script that renders all ten through opengl3 + Xvfb in one load where possible, and a report per shot (luminance p1/p5/p50/p95/p99, saturation mean, colour temperature estimate, frame cost from GEO), written as JSON and a 2x5 contact sheet, plus a compare mode that diffs two runs and flags shots that moved beyond a tolerance. Document how the lead uses it. Push wt/ref-cameras, contact sheet on shots/ref-cameras.

G4: a grade tuned per hour. The look LUT (adjustment_color_correction gradient) is one curve for all hours. Make the grade follow the hour and weather from DayNight: a crisper midday, warm rich golden hour, cool blue hour, night with deep blacks and no lavender cast, the marine layer greyer; keep AgX and the LUT approach (CLAUDE.md Look note), measure each hour's p5/p50/p95 against the targets in CLAUDE.md, judge on Forward+ in a small scene and on the opengl3 bookmarks. Before/after stills per hour on shots/color-grade. Push wt/color-grade.

CLAUDE.md: lamps are still primitives and code, next in line for real assets. Build a Blender-scripted kit (tools/make_street_lamps.py, like tools/make_signals.py) of Los Angeles street lights at real size: the cobra-head on a tapered galvanised pole, the downtown twin-globe ornamental on a fluted cast-iron post, the midtown single-lantern ornamental, a residential post-top, and a mast-arm LED; each with its lamp head as a lit part and UV2 for the shader. Pick the type by district and street (hash), keep the existing lamp_light OmniLights, pools and NightCity's sodium/LED roll. Triangle budget per lamp (TRI_BUDGET), LODs, shadow twin. Stills day and night, close and down a street, before/after on shots/street-lamps.

The street's signs as real models: green street-name blades on every corner pole (the plan's names, reflective, lit by headlights at night through the retroreflective cone the freeway signs use), stop and yield signs with real octagon / triangle faces and backs, speed limits, no-parking and time-limit plates, one-way and turn-lane signs on signal mast arms, school-zone signs near schools. Blender- or code-built at real size, hash-placed at the junctions StreetDetail already decides, on one shader with the faces' text from a stroke font. Stills of a corner day and night before/after on shots/street-signs.

Real models for the pavement furniture LA actually has: fire hydrants (the squat LA wet-barrel type), parking meters (single-head, and pay stations), bus benches with painted ad backs (invented advertisers: realtors, injury lawyers, 555 numbers), trash bins (the metal-mesh downtown bin, the green and blue residential carts on collection day), bike racks, newspaper-free kerb planters. Blender- or code-built at real size, one batch per kind a chunk, hash-placed where StreetDetail already puts the old primitives (replace them, keep their ids, rolls and collision). Close-up and street stills before/after on shots/street-furniture. (prop-destruction owns the break effects; you own the meshes.)

The road surface's hardware: manhole covers (cast-iron patterns, slightly proud or sunk, with the asphalt patched round them), storm drain kerb inlets with their grates and a stencilled original "drains to ocean" plaque, water and gas valve covers, steel road plates over trenches, raised pavement markers and old Botts' dots on surface streets, utility cuts. Code-built, hash-placed per block and lane (never in crosswalks), one batch each, wet look from road_wetness. Close stills before/after on shots/road-detail.

LA's kerbs and pavement edges: painted kerb zones (red no stopping at hydrants and corners, yellow loading, white passenger, green short-term, blue disabled) with worn paint and stencilled numbers, kerb ramps with yellow truncated-dome pads and their cut, driveway aprons dipping across the pavement, tree wells with cast-iron grates or bare dirt, slabs heaved and cracked by street-tree roots, house numbers stencilled on the kerb in the suburbs. Hash-placed from the plan and the lots, in the road and pavement shaders or one batch per kind. Stills before/after on shots/kerbs.

Overhead utilities as real geometry: wooden poles with crossarms, pin insulators, pole-top transformers (cans), streetlight arms on some, guy wires and anchors, communication cable bundles and splice cases lower down, service drops to every house in the suburbs and beach town, catenary sag per span, and the alley poles. Read how StreetDetail and Birds build the existing spans (Birds._wire_spans()) and keep that polyline as the truth so birds still land on the wires. Code- or Blender-built, batched per chunk, wires as cheap camera-facing ribbons with LOD. Stills before/after on shots/utility-poles.

G2's per-style kits: Los Angeles stucco apartment buildings in MIDTOWN and the inner SUBURBS - two- and three-storey walk-ups with open exterior stairs and walkways, courtyard (bungalow court) apartments round a planted court, the 1960s "dingbat" already exists in the beach town (HouseKit DINGBAT) so do the larger types: four-storey podium apartments over a garage gate, 1920s Spanish courtyard buildings with tile roofs. Plan pure from hashes per lot (like HouseKit / Industrial), claim lots AFTER every existing roll, build FULL geometry (one mesh per material a chunk), LOD and far city as coded boxes. Stills before/after on shots/apartments.

Downtown's historic core (Spring St and Main St, the old banks and office blocks; CLAUDE.md: 14-80 m of stone, brick and render) as beaux-arts buildings: rusticated two-storey bases with arched openings, giant-order columns or pilasters, heavy bracketed cornices, decorated attic storeys, terracotta, bronze shopfronts, lit entrances. Broadway's theatres (merged) are the neighbour: do not touch Broadway itself. Built from the existing Building + facade kit route or as a new kit keyed to those blocks by hash, at real geometry near, coded far. Street stills day and night before/after on shots/historic-core.

Places of worship across the city, original and respectful: a Mission Revival church with bell tower and arcade, a modern concrete church, a small storefront church, a Greek-revival temple-front church, a Buddhist temple, a synagogue - seeded on lots by hash after every existing roll, at real size, with grounds, lit at night. Every one gets the Sanctuary zone (scripts/weapons/sanctuary.gd, CLAUDE.md's masjid note) and StreetWear / Encampment keep their distance (WORSHIP_IDS, WORSHIP_CLEAR). Stills on shots/churches.

Neighbourhood civic buildings: branch libraries (Spanish revival and mid-century), post offices with the flag and mail trucks (an invented postal service), a city services office, community centres. Seeded per district by hash on lots after every existing roll (skip lots fire stations, police stations, schools and hospitals claim), real geometry near, coded far, lit at night, a few people and vehicles. Stills on shots/civic-buildings.

A Hollywood film studio lot (original studio name): a walled block of huge numbered sound stages (beige, with elephant doors and painted stage numbers), office bungalows, a gate with a guard booth and the studio's arch, a water tower with the studio's invented logo, a backlot "New York street" of false fronts, trailers and equipment trucks, golf carts, crews. A site claimed by hash in MIDTOWN like the civic sites (Landmarks entry, site rect, far version). Stills on shots/film-studio.

A weekly street farmers' market: one closed street or plaza per few km by hash, white pop-up canopies in rows with produce, flower and bread stalls (code-built produce crates in colour), vans behind, string lights, shoppers who browse (crowd life clips), busy mornings on the market day and packed up otherwise (the hour and a day roll). Stills busy and packed-up on shots/farmers-market.

A historic Mexican marketplace lane near Pueblo Station (the form of a real one, an original name): a short brick-paved pedestrian lane under a pergola of vines, rows of puesto stalls with colourful goods, papel picado strung overhead, an adobe house, a small plaza with a kiosk bandstand and a church facing it (that church gets the Sanctuary zone). Built as a civic site (CivicSites table, real place relative to the station), crowds. Stills on shots/olvera.

A Chinatown district north of the civic centre (original names): a gateway over the street, buildings with sweeping tiled roofs and painted eaves, lanterns strung across the street lit at night, a central plaza with a pagoda-roofed building, shops with goods out front. Done respectfully, no caricature; signs in invented names. A district overlay on a few blocks by hash or a site table. Stills day and night on shots/chinatown.

A memorial park on a gentle hill: lawn cemetery with flat markers in rows, some upright headstones and older monuments, mausoleum, mature trees and a chapel, a winding road, lit gate. Respectful: the Sanctuary zone covers it (no shooting at or into it), no damage effects. Site claimed by hash in the suburbs. Stills on shots/cemetery.

A walk-of-fame boulevard: one boulevard through midtown whose pavement is laid with terrazzo stars (invented names, never real people), tourist souvenir shops, a grand movie palace forecourt with handprints (invented), costumed street characters (original, no copyrighted characters), tour buses, neon at night. Hash-chosen boulevard, StreetDetail-style pavement decals and shop overrides. Stills day and night on shots/star-boulevard.

Downtown's fashion district (east of the core, south of 7th): wholesale shops with racks of clothes and bolts of fabric spilling onto the pavement under awnings, a narrow market alley crowded with stalls, mannequins, hand trucks and people with bags. A district overlay on the blocks there by hash, using the shop interiors and street clutter systems. Stills on shots/fashion-district.

One kind of building the player can walk into: a corner convenience store (original name) with real interior geometry - shelves of product (code-built boxes and bottles in batches), drink coolers glowing, a counter with a cashier, lottery and cigarette racks, ceiling lights, a door that opens. Seeded on corner lots by hash in MIDTOWN and SUBURBS; the facade matches what the shop interior shader drew; interior culled when the player is outside it. Stills inside and out on shots/walk-in-store.

A multi-storey car park the player can drive up: real ramps, decks with stalls and parked cars, columns, low ceilings with lights, an exit down, barriers at the entry. Seeded on lots by hash downtown and midtown where LotFill already builds parking podiums (use them or add standalone structures), collision on every deck. Drive a car up in a still sequence. Stills on shots/garage-drive-in.

The light rail's underground terminus at 7th St is only two stair kiosks in Flower's median (LightRail). Build the station under them: stairs and escalators down to a concourse with fare gates and ticket machines, a platform level with the coral line's livery, tiled walls, signs, lights, waiting riders, and the trains (LightRailSystem draws nobody in the tunnel: draw them here when the player is inside). Collision for walking. Stills on shots/metro-underground.

Pedestrian bridges over the freeways and wide boulevards near schools and parks: steel truss or concrete spans with chain-link cages arching over the walkway, ramps or stairs at both ends, lights, graffiti. Placed where a freeway crosses between two city blocks by hash (Freeway segments + CityPlan), collision so the player can cross. Stills on shots/footbridges.

The bay and the coast are empty water. Ambient boats under way, scripted like AirTraffic's aircraft (no physics, AnimatableBody3D on props, take_hit): sailboats heeling and tacking, motor yachts with wakes, sport-fishing boats, a harbour pilot boat, a ferry crossing to the island, tugs at the port, container ships at anchor offshore with lights at night. Code-built hulls at real size with LODs, wakes as cheap foam on the ocean shader's terms. Do not do player-drivable boats (speedboats owns that). Stills on shots/ocean-traffic.

A large island on the horizon offshore (the form of the Channel Islands, original name): a far silhouette of mountains 30-40 km out across the water, hazy blue by day, hard against the sunset, invisible in the marine layer, a few lights at the island's one town at night. Far geometry only (beyond the 12 km camera far plane is not drawn: work out how, e.g. a sky-drawn silhouette in sky.gdshader's horizon or a mesh inside the far plane scaled to subtend the right angle). Stills from the beach and the hills, day, sunset and night, on shots/offshore-island.

The decorated offshore oil islands in the bay (the form of Long Beach's, original): man-made islands of boulders a few hundred metres across with palm trees, waterfalls, tall pastel-lit towers that hide the drilling rigs, sound walls, lit at night. In the bay off the port / Long Beach shore (MacroMap bay), far versions for the horizon. Stills from the shore, the air, and at night on shots/oil-islands.

A lighthouse on the headland (the form of Point Fermin's: a Victorian lighthouse house with a lantern room) and a breakwater light at the end of a long rock breakwater off the port; rotating beams at night (an additive beam mesh, a volumetric beam only on Forward+ HIGH), the light visible from far across the basin through aircraft_lights.gdshader's point-light approach. Stills day and night on shots/lighthouses.

Life in the water: a pod of dolphins arcing beyond the surf line now and then, sea lions hauled out on a harbour buoy and barking, pelicans gliding in a line along the waves and diving (coordinate with Birds' patterns: same MultiMesh approach, code-built meshes), a whale spout far offshore rarely. Code-built at real size, cheap, hash-timed. Stills on shots/sea-life.

A coast highway north of the beach town along the ocean (the form of PCH under the bluffs): a four-lane road between the sand and a cliff, beach houses on pilings over the sand on the ocean side with their decks and stairs, cars parked along the shoulder, lifeguard towers, surfers' vans. Fit it into MacroMap's coast where the city meets the sea north of the pier (read MacroMap and ReplicaAreas first; it must not cut through existing districts). Stills on shots/coast-highway.

Player-drivable boats: a speedboat and a jet ski at the marina's docks, entered like a car (interact), riding on the ocean shader's waves (buoyancy from the same Gerstner sum in GDScript, as Surf mirrors the surf), with a wake and spray, throttle and steering on the car controls, beached on sand, sinking when destroyed. Extends Vehicle or a new class with the same enter/exit contract. Stills of a run across the bay on shots/speedboats.

Beach bonfire rings at night (the form of Dockweiler's concrete fire rings): rings along the beach above the tide line, lit after dusk with a fire (CarDamage's fire material style), smoke, a warm light on the sand, small groups of people sitting round them (BeachFigure bakes), empty by day. Hash-placed per shore cell like BeachLife. Stills at 21:00 on shots/bonfires.

The beach's public amenities: an outdoor gym pen on the sand (pull-up bars, rings, benches), outdoor showers on the path, concrete restroom blocks, a concession stand with a rental counter, bike racks, beach volleyball poles beyond the court BeachLife has, trash cans on the sand. Hash-placed per shore stretch away from BeachLife's people and props. Stills on shots/beach-amenities.

An oil refinery in the industrial south near the port (the form of the Wilmington refineries, original company): crude tank farms with floating roofs in containment berms, distillation columns, cracking units with stair towers and pipe racks, flare stacks with a flame and heat shimmer, cooling towers with steam plumes, a maze of lit platforms at night (it is a city of lights after dark). A site claimed by hash on INDUSTRIAL blocks near the port, far version for the night aerial. Stills day, night and from the air on shots/refinery.

A gas-fired power plant on the coast (the form of the El Segundo / Redondo plants, original): turbine halls, tall twin stacks with red aviation lights, a switchyard of transformers and lattice towers, transmission lines leaving it (coordinate with ridges' lines by sharing the line style, not the code), a seawall. A site on the coast between the airport and the beach town or near the port, chosen to fit MacroMap. Stills on shots/power-plant.

The hills' rock is painted (terrain splat outcrops). Add real photoscanned rock (Poly Haven CC0 rocks and cliff pieces, decimated with a tool like tools/decimate_tree.py for hard surfaces) on the crests and the steepest faces where HillPlanting already says rock, and boulders along the hill roads' cut banks: placed in FULL hill chunks by the same field, LODs and shadow twins, the far tier keeping only big ones. Stills of a ridge before/after on shots/rock-outcrops.

Dry creek beds in the canyon floors (the erosion's drainage: last_drain, HillPlanting.hollow()): a sandy, cobbled wash winding down each major gully, boulders, sycamores and willows along it, culverts where hill roads cross. FULL hill chunks only, planted from the same drainage field so it follows the land; LOD chunks a painted strip. Stills from a hill road and the air before/after on shots/arroyos.

Urban wildlife: coyotes trotting across hill roads and the edges of the suburbs at dusk and night, mule deer in the hills at dawn, squirrels in parks and on lawns, rabbits on the hill grass, raccoons by bins at night. Code-built meshes at real size with fur on the dogs' approach (read DogMesh) or simpler where they are small, a procedural gait, flee from the player and from gunfire, ragdoll-free (they run off). Hash-spawned round the player like Birds. Stills on shots/wildlife.

The crowd's heads: people turn their heads (and a little of the chest) toward nearby events - the player boosting past or landing hard, a car crash, a blast, a police siren, a busker - with eased, capped turns, a glance at passers-by, and look-away; a SkeletonModifier3D on the crowd rigs (like AimTwist), only near the camera, cheap. Read VISUAL_ROADMAP row 28 first and do what it left. Stills/frame sequences on shots/crowd-lookat.

G5: foot placement on uneven ground for the crowd and the hero: feet planted on kerbs, stairs, slopes and the hill paths instead of floating or sinking; hips lowered to the lower foot; ray per foot near the camera only, TwoBoneIK3D or a custom modifier after the clips, faded with distance. Stills of people on a kerb, the beach stairs and a slope before/after on shots/foot-ik.

The crowd's own garments (tools/crowd/garments.py: tees, trousers, button shirts, zip jacket) are only worn by eight rigs. Add new garment types in that pipeline - a hoodie with hood and pouch, a dress, a skirt, cargo shorts, a work jacket, a puffer - and build NEW rigs crowd_u.. wearing them (do not rebuild the existing rigs), keeping every contract in CLAUDE.md's crowd notes (one Body surface, region colours, welded bodies, hats, life clips retargeted, hat table refit). Lineup stills on shots/garments-2.

What a crowd does after chaos dies down: once panic ends near a wreck, a blast site or a body, people come back in a loose ring at a distance, film it on their phones (the phone clip, the screen lit), point, cover their mouths, one or two call for help on the phone; they leave as responders arrive. Built on crowd life (CrowdLife, Pedestrian's life section), near the camera only. Stills on shots/onlookers.

Drivers react to chaos: gunfire or a blast near a traffic car makes its driver brake hard, swerve, mount the kerb, reverse out, or abandon the car with the door open and run (a Pedestrian spawned at the driver's door with the panic clip, CarCabin's occupant cleared); cars behind honk and try to go round; nothing is the player's crime unless a person is hit. Built on Traffic's existing states and Pedestrian.alarm(); coordinate with traffic-ai's lane logic by staying in your own functions. Stills/sequences on shots/car-panic.

Street performers: a guitarist with an open case, a drummer on buckets, a breakdancer with a ring of watchers, a living statue painted silver, a mariachi trio, on busy pavements downtown, at the beach boardwalk and on plazas; hash-placed per block, built on crowd life (clips from the UAL set, retargeted as tools/crowd/life_clips.gd does), audio from CC0 recordings if available (else none), flee from gunfire and come back. Stills on shots/buskers.

Valet stands at hotels and restaurants: a podium with an umbrella and a key box at the kerb, valets in uniform who run to arriving cars, drive them off to a lot round the block and bring cars back, a short queue of cars with hazards on. At the hotels (live_hotel, airport and downtown towers with lobbies) and busy restaurant blocks by hash, cars from TrafficManager's pool. Stills on shots/valets.

TV news at big scenes: after a big blast or a long police standoff, news vans (code-built, invented stations, satellite masts that raise) pull up near the scene, a reporter with a cameraman and a light talks to camera behind tape, joining the news helicopter AirTraffic already sends. Dispatched like Emergency (scripts/npc/emergency.gd), pooled, leave after a while. Stills on shots/news-crews.

The Ragdoll keeps the rigged model as ONE tumbling body (CLAUDE.md). Make bodies fall like people: a jointed ragdoll (PhysicalBoneSimulator3D / PhysicalBone3D per major bone with cone-twist limits, or a few rigid bodies with joints) driven by the knock impulse, settling on kerbs and car bonnets, with the cost bounded (max simulated ragdolls, freeze to the old single body after settling, LOD by distance). Keep dismemberment, blood, wounds, limbs, Emergency's patients and every Ragdoll API working. Before/after sequences on shots/ragdolls.

The crowd in the rain: when Weather rains, people put up umbrellas (code-built, opened and held by the grip frame of CrowdLife, a few colours), pull hoods, hurry (faster walk), shelter under awnings, bus shelters and doorways, and the streets empty out under a downpour; umbrellas fold when it stops. Built on crowd life, near the camera only. Stills of a rainy street before/after on shots/rain-crowd.

Motorcycles: a sport bike, a cruiser and a scooter, Blender-built like tools/make_road_cars.py at real size, in traffic (lane filtering between queued cars is a bonus) and parked at kerbs, and rideable by the player (interact) with lean in turns, wheelies on boost, the rider thrown off in a crash (ragdoll), stabilised flight in the air like the cars. A Vehicle subclass or sibling with the same enter/exit and traffic contracts. Stills on shots/motorcycles.

A flyable helicopter: the player can take a helicopter from the helipads (rooftops, the hospital, the police HQ, the airport) and fly it - collective on jump/boost, cyclic on the move axes, yaw - with the rotor disc shader and rotor sound AirTraffic's Helicopter uses, a downwash that kicks dust and bends palms below, and crash physics. Reuse the Helicopter model (tools/make_helicopter.py). Stills on shots/heli-flyable.

Lowriders, very LA: two Blender-built classic bodies (a 1960s full-size hardtop and a 1980s coupe) with candy paint and deep metal flake (car_paint.gdshader's flake), wire wheels, chrome, pinstripes, lowered stance; hydraulics that hop and three-wheel at a weekend cruise night on a boulevard (parked in a row at a car meet with people round them), and now and then cruising slow in traffic bouncing. Stills on shots/lowriders.

G6: real car interiors and doors for the player's car. The traced cabin (car_cabin.gdshaderinc) stays for traffic; the car the player drives (and parked cars within a few metres) gets real geometry: dashboard, seats, steering wheel that turns, door cards, and doors as hinged parts that swing open when the player gets in and out (and that fly off in a crash). Built from tools/make_road_cars.py's specs (doors already exist as panel gaps) as separate nodes per body; LOD'd away. Stills of getting in and of the interior on shots/car-cabins.

Vehicle audio: an engine sound per body type (CC0 recordings: small four, V8, diesel truck, bus, motorcycle-ready) pitched and crossfaded by speed and a simulated gear, idle, rev on boost, tyre squeal on hard turns and braking, a turbo whistle on the exotics, horn per car, the reverse beeper on trucks and buses. Through Sfx (buses, loudness tables in SAMPLE_LOUDNESS_DB). Nearest cars only. Document the sources in docs/ASSETS.md. No stills needed (screenshots of the audio debug HUD are fine).

A chaos-sandbox playground: seeded stunt features in the city - a kicker ramp on the top deck of a car park, a quarter-pipe in the river channel, a loop-the-loop and a ramp pair over a freeway in the industrial district, a ramp off the pier, jump lines in a vacant lot - code-built with collision, hash-placed where they fit (never blocking traffic lanes), with a stunt camera moment (slow-mo on a big jump, Engine.time_scale on the real clock as the weapon wheel does). Stills mid-jump on shots/stunt-ramps.

Street props that break like GTA: a fire hydrant knocked over by a car sends up a water geyser (particles, wet ground under it, sound) for a while, glass bus shelters shatter into cubes, lamp posts bend and fall when hit hard, mailboxes and news boxes burst open with paper, parking meters snap off. Behaviour on the existing props by their kind (CityChunk._add_prop health and take_hit) and PhysicsBudget debris; work off the prop KIND, not its mesh (street-furniture and street-lamps are replacing meshes in parallel). Stills mid-break on shots/prop-destruction.

A wingsuit for the overpowered hero: after a high jump or off a tower, a key (or holding jump in a dive) opens a wingsuit - glide with pitch and roll on the move axes, speed from diving, a whoosh, the boost trail turned into wingtip vapour, landing by flaring into a run or a skid; the hero's pose from hero-moves' air poses. Player state code kept in a new file with a small hook in player.gd. Stills of a glide over the city on shots/wingsuit.

The hero swims: in the ocean, the marina, pools and MacArthur Park's lake he floats at the surface (the ocean's Gerstner height from GDScript, as Surf mirrors it), swims with a stroke animation (a clip retargeted like the life clips), dives under, splashes and a wake, and boosts out of the water like a dolphin; drowning is not a thing. Small hook in player.gd. Stills on shots/swimming.

A car radio for the player's car: four original stations (invented names and DJ idents built from CC0 voice samples or none) playing CC0 / public-domain music tracks streamed from assets/audio/radio (keep the total small: this ships in a macOS app and a web page), next / prev station on a key and the mouse wheel in a car, a station name card on the HUD, music on the Game bus muffled by slow motion like everything else. Sources in docs/ASSETS.md. HUD stills on shots/car-radio.

A film shoot on location (very LA): a street closed for a shoot - trailers and equipment trucks parked along it, a camera on a dolly and a crane, big lights on stands and a balloon light at night, a catering tent, crew in black, extras, orange "filming in progress" notices on poles (invented production names). Hash-chosen street per few km, the closure through CityPlan.road_open's pattern (one small hook). Stills day and night on shots/film-shoot.

Weekend yard sales in the suburbs: folding tables on the lawn and the driveway with boxes, lamps, clothes on a rack, a bike, a sofa, handwritten signs on the corner poles, neighbours browsing. Hash-chosen houses on the weekend days (a day roll like the farmers market's), built from YardFill's plan of the yard and the house. Stills on shots/yard-sales.

Backyard life in the suburbs and the beach town: patio furniture and umbrellas, barbecues with smoke at dinner time, string lights at night, trampolines, kids' toys are out (no children), pool floats on pools, laundry, citrus trees, dog runs. On YardFill's back-yard plan, hash per lot, one batch per kind a chunk, visible from the air and from over the fence. Stills from the air at noon and 21:00 on shots/backyards.

The freeway's everyday incidents: a stalled car on the shoulder with hazards and its driver standing by, a highway patrol car (invented agency) behind it with lights, a tow truck arriving; tyre debris and a mattress in a lane that traffic swerves round; changeable message signs on some gantries with invented messages; occasional slowdowns. Hash-timed per route and segment, built on TrafficManager's freeway lanes with small hooks. Stills on shots/freeway-incidents.

Outdoor dining parklets: wooden decks built out into the parking lane in front of cafes and restaurants (the shop interiors already know which shops are cafes and restaurants: Building.shop_room_codes()), with planters and railings, tables under umbrellas, string lights at night, diners sitting and eating (crowd life seat clips), waiters. Parked cars keep off their stretch after their rolls. Stills day and night on shots/parklets.

Night life: queues outside clubs and bars on busy blocks after 21:00 (people standing in a line along the wall, a bouncer and a velvet rope, a lit entrance), sky-sweeping searchlights at a premiere at the movie palaces or a club opening (beams on Forward+ HIGH volumetric, a drawn beam elsewhere like the helicopter's), taxis and ride-hail pickups double-parked with hazards. Built on crowd life and the shop rolls. Stills at 22:00 on shots/nightlife.

Fireworks over the beach and the stadium on some nights (a date / day roll, and a debug switch FIREWORKS=1 to force them): shells rising with a trail, bursts of different types (peony, willow, crossette, strobe), coloured light flashing on the water and the city, delayed booms by distance (speed of sound), smoke drifting with the wind. GPU-cheap particles, Compatibility-safe. Stills mid-show from the pier and the hills on shots/fireworks.

Aerial advertising: an advertising blimp (original brand) circling over the stadium and the beach by day, its LED side panel lit at night, and small planes towing banner ads (invented, readable letters) slowly along the beach. Scripted on AirRoutes like AirTraffic, code-built at real size, take_hit and a crash for the chaos. Stills on shots/sky-ads.

Window-washing gondolas on the downtown glass towers: a suspended platform with two workers hanging on cables from a roof davit, moving slowly down a face, water streaks behind them; plus a few roof davits and building maintenance units parked on tower roofs. Placed by hash on the landmark towers (LandmarkDowntown) and tall core infill, near the camera only, shootable (the platform swings, the workers hang on). Stills on shots/tower-gondolas.

A beach skate park (it was in the last fleet but never started): a concrete bowl and street section near the beach boardwalk - bowls with coping, a snake run, ledges, rails, stairs, a half-pipe - with skaters riding them (scripted lines like BeachRider's skater, kickflips as a pose flip), spectators on the edge, graffiti. A site by the boardwalk fit to MacroMap's beach. Stills on shots/skate-park.

A settings screen in the pause menu (scripts/ui/pause_menu.gd's frosted chips style): mouse sensitivity and invert, camera FOV, field-of-view in cars, audio volumes per bus (Master, World, Ambience), graphics toggles that map onto Quality's knobs (motion blur, depth of field, film grain, vignette, render scale), HUD scale, all saved to user:// with ConfigFile and applied at startup. Stills of the screen on shots/settings-menu.

Owner request: street surfaces detailed and unique from at most 25 wear stamps (potholes, cracking, patches, tar snakes, ruts, ravelling...) varied by hash into thousands (rotation, mirror, scale, age, wear threshold, pair blends, wetness); potholes with real depth; placement by district and wheel path; one batch per chunk.
